heading.title: Of Transfers of Property by Act of Parties1

article.title: Oral transfer.
article.content: A transfer of property may be made without writing in every case in which a writing is not expressly required by law.
article.html:
9Oral transfer.

Section 9 · Chapter II · (A) Transfer of Property, whether moveable or immoveable · page 11 of the Act

A transfer of property may be made without writing in every case in which a writing is not expressly required by law.
